question: Which team won the Women's FIFA Football World Cup in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**US**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **US** Women's National Soccer Team won the Women's FIFA Football World Cup in **2019**.
 
• This victory marked their **fourth title** in the history of the Women's World Cup.
 
• The final match was held on **July 7, 2019**, in Lyon, France, where the US defeated the Netherlands with a score of **2-0**.
 
• Megan Rapinoe and Rose Lavelle scored the goals for the US team in the final match.
 
• The US team was coached by **Jill Ellis**, who also led the team to victory in the 2015 Women's World Cup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Women's FIFA Football World Cup is an international football competition contested by the senior women's national teams of the members of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA).
 
• The first Women's World Cup tournament was held in 1991, and it has been held every four years since then.
 
• The 2019 tournament was the **eighth edition** of the Women's World Cup.
 
• The US Women's National Soccer Team is the most successful team in the history of the Women's World Cup, having won titles in **1991, 1999, 2015, and 2019**.
 
• The US team has also been known for its advocacy for gender equality and equal pay in sports.
